== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The 2003 and 2004 supplements repeat the original and classify its control-phase move as unlimited. The period relocation between locations rule supports the same movement kind in the 2006 control-phase clause. The separate later deployment option drops its printed own deploy-phase condition, while keeping the same eligible types and Dagobah restrictions override.
